text: EQUITY IN NET ASSETS OF AFFILIATED COMPANIES

name: us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentsPolicy
text: We use the equity method of accounting for our investments in entities over which we do not have control, but over whose operating and financial policies we are able to exercise significant influence. We assess an investment for potential impairment when a change in circumstance indicates its carrying value may not be recoverable.
